text: Select: assay.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target.target_type, target.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value. Source: activities (act), assays (assay), target_dictionary (target), molecule_dictionary (md), compound_structures (cs). Join: act.assay_id = assay.assay_id, assay.tid = target.tid, act.molregno = md.molregno, md.molregno = cs.molregno. Filter: target.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293267', act.standard_type = 'IC50', act.standard_relation = '=', act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort: md.chembl_id ASC, assay.chembl_id ASC. Limit: 1000.
